  "global_prompt": "[CURRENT CHUNK BOUNDARIES]
For every FL2VA chunk, <Picture 1> is the exact complete opening frame and <Picture 2> is the exact complete final frame. Animate one physically continuous transition between them. Treat both pictures as temporal boundaries, not loose visual references. The middle keyframe is reused automatically: it is <Picture 2> at the end of chunk 1 and <Picture 1> at the beginning of chunk 2.

[SUBJECT DEFINITIONS]
<Subject 1> is the same frightened swamp goblin throughout: olive-green deeply wrinkled skin, long pointed ears, pale green eyes, long hooked pink nose, uneven teeth, wet dark hair woven with yellow marsh flowers and leaves, soaked black sleeves, stained beige shirt and worn brown vest. Preserve his exact face, age, costume, flower crown and body proportions.
<Subject 2> is one enormous water demon emerging behind him: a towering dark horned silhouette formed from black swamp water, mud and mist. It is a single coherent creature, much larger than <Subject 1>, never a second goblin.

[WORLD AND CONTINUITY]
One fog-bound flooded forest at cold dawn. Bare trunks recede into white mist; still waist-deep water carries circular ripples, dripping cloth and muted reflections. Maintain the same waterline, forest geography, light direction, fog density and desaturated green-brown palette across both chunks.

[CAMERA AND IMAGE]
One continuous cinematic progression from a medium shot to a close-up and finally an extreme close-up. The camera advances on the same lens axis at eye level with credible foreground-water parallax. Soft backlight through fog, realistic wet skin, restrained contrast and shallow depth of field. No cut, dissolve, reverse angle, sudden lens change or disconnected zoom.

[PERFORMANCE AND SPEECH]
Build fear in readable stages: uncertainty, recognition, physical recoil, then a desperate shouted warning. Preserve accurate eye focus, breathing, shoulders, elbows, wrists and five fingers on each visible hand. English dialogue must have clearly synchronized lips and a strained goblin voice.

[PRODUCTION SOUND]
Native synchronized swamp sound: water movement around the torso, wet cloth, distant frogs falling silent, branches creaking, a deep submerged rumble, the demon displacing water, frightened breathing and close English dialogue. No non-diegetic music.

[CONTINUITY SAFEGUARDS]
Keep one <Subject 1> and one <Subject 2>. No identity drift, duplicate goblin, duplicate demon, flower-crown change, costume change, extra arms, fused fingers, floating hands, random camera cut, subtitle, on-screen text, watermark or logo.",

  "director_local_prompts": "[CHUNK 1 - DISCOVERY]
Open exactly on <Picture 1>: <Subject 1> stands waist-deep in the swamp in a medium shot, reaching one wet hand toward the camera, still unaware of the danger behind him. Arrive exactly on <Picture 2>: both hands are raised, his mouth is open in alarm, and the huge blurred horns and dark mass of <Subject 2> have risen behind his head.

[TIMED ACTION]
0.00-1.20s: hold the opening composition. <Subject 1> wades forward slightly, blinks and reaches toward the lens; only small ripples and dripping sleeves disturb the water.
1.20-2.80s: a low submerged vibration begins. Water behind him swells and separates; the shadow and two horns of <Subject 2> rise slowly through the fog. <Subject 1> hears it before seeing it and freezes mid-breath.
2.80-4.20s: his eyes shift over one shoulder, then widen. He recoils toward camera and raises both hands in one anatomically continuous movement while the demon becomes enormous behind him.
4.20s-end: settle exactly into <Picture 2>. His hands are fully raised, the demon remains out of focus behind him, and he gasps with synchronized lips: <Subject 1> (S1): <d>[English] Something is moving behind me...</d>

[CAMERA]
Use a slow, steady push from medium shot toward medium close-up on the same axis. Let the demon appear through background scale, water displacement and focus separation rather than a cut.

[ACTING]
Play the realization progressively: listening first, then eye movement, breath stopping, shoulders tightening and finally the defensive hands. Do not begin at full panic. | [CHUNK 2 - WARNING]
Open exactly on <Picture 1>: <Subject 1> is already in a medium close-up with both hands raised and <Subject 2> towering behind him. Arrive exactly on <Picture 2>: an extreme close-up of the same goblin screaming, with identical face, flower crown, wet hair and clothing; the demon remains physically behind him but falls outside the very tight frame.

0.00-0.80s: preserve the exact opening pose for a brief terrified beat. The goblin stares past the camera while the demon sends a heavy wave forward.
0.80-2.20s: <Subject 1> lunges one step toward the lens, hands still high, as the camera makes a controlled rapid push-in. Water splashes against his vest; his eyes lock directly onto the viewer.
2.20-4.50s: in one desperate breath he shouts with large, precisely synchronized mouth shapes: <Subject 1> (S1): <d>[English] Run! Watch out for the water demons!</d>
4.50s-end: finish the final word while arriving exactly at <Picture 2>. Hold the extreme close-up for the last instant, mouth open, eyes wide and breath shaking.

[CAMERA]
Continue the same forward camera axis from the previous chunk. Evolve smoothly from medium close-up to extreme close-up; increasing facial scale must come from physical camera movement and the goblin stepping forward, not a jump zoom.

[ACTING AND SOUND]
The warning is raw and urgent, with a cracked high goblin voice, wet breath and strong swamp reverberation. Under the line, use one massive water impact, a deep demon growl and branches snapping behind him. Keep the dialogue intelligible and do not add other voices. | ",
